stem.text: The photomicrographs show a cross-section through the lining of part of the respiratory system.

stem.alt: Two greyscale micrographs side by side: a light micrograph of a cross-section through a folded tissue lining with a small rectangle marked on the upper ridge, and two lines running from the rectangle to an enlarged electron micrograph showing hair-like structures along the top edge and cells beneath.

items: Goblet cells are visible between squamous epithelium cells.
The section cannot be from a bronchiole as cartilage is visible.
